geopolitics_summary: Russia refinery strikes halt diesel exports; Iran sanctions reimposed; Middle East conflict escalates—tight crude/fuel supply backdrop pressures EU gas via LNG displacement.

themes.headline: Russia halts diesel exports after Ukraine refinery strikes
themes.why_it_matters: Loss of Russian diesel export capacity tightens global refined product markets; EU refineries must source crude elsewhere, raising margins and competing for LNG-alternative gas cargoes. Indirect TTF/power support via fuel-switching headroom.

themes.headline: Trump administration reimposes sanctions on Iran oil sales
themes.why_it_matters: Removes ~1M b/d Iranian crude from market; supports Brent, reduces global LNG switching incentive, keeping TTF elevated relative to Asian hubs. Indirect upside for EU power via dampened gas arbitrage.

themes.headline: Middle East conflict escalates; IMF warns of economic spillover
themes.why_it_matters: Renewed Hormuz disruption risk elevates crude risk premium; tightens LNG market and supports TTF via competing feedstock demand. Indirect inflation driver for power via input costs and macro demand destruction.

themes.headline: EU shipyard services Russia LNG fleet before sanctions take effect
themes.why_it_matters: Maintains Russian LNG export capacity post-sanctions, prolonging supply of spot LNG to compete with EU demand. Direct bearish TTF pressure if additional sanctions delayed or Russian cargoes continue flowing.

themes.headline: Italy pushes to weaken EU green rules in €2 trillion budget framework
themes.why_it_matters: Weakened EU climate/environmental criteria reduce clean-energy investment incentives and extend lifetime of fossil-fuel infrastructure. Neutral near-term; downside EUA and upside for coal/gas if enforcement diluted.

watchlist: EU sanctions on Russian LNG fleet servicing—implementation date and scope (direct TTF impact).
NATO fuel pipeline upgrade cost agreement—could unlock alternative to Russian/spot gas (months out).
German Nord Stream sabotage trial developments—geopolitical signal on EU-Ukraine relations and gas policy.
Iran crude re-entry timeline and US sanction enforcement—watch for Strait of Hormuz insurance premiums.
